item.title: AI-powered cameras to record drivers holding mobile phones or without seatbelts

item.title: Illegal fireworks: €50,000 fines and criminal liability for couples at weddings and baptisms
item.description: People who use illegal fireworks at weddings and baptisms — along with event organisers and venue operators — will now face criminal prosecution, as parliament approved sweeping changes to the law, including a tenfold increase in fines to €50,000. item.title: Cyprus and Israel to sign Aphrodite gas field deal in 2026, president says
item.description: Cyprus expects to sign an agreement with Israel in 2026 for the development and exploitation of the Aphrodite gas field, President Nicos Christodoulides announced on Wednesday, “thus closing a long-standing issue” and taking another substantial step towards utilising the country’s energy resources. item.description: Cyprus will launch its first AI Factory in the immediate future and is advancing creation of a national supercomputer in partnership with an American technology giant, President Nicos Christodoulides announced on Wednesday, positioning the country at the forefront of artificial intelligence and high-performance computing in the Eastern Mediterranean.
